DisableVision.Label: Disable Vision?
DisableVision.Hint: Turns Token Vision off on the created Scenes.

DisableGrid.Label: Disable Grid?
DisableGrid.Hint: Sets the grid of the created Scenes to Gridless.

AutoBackgroundColor.Label: Set Background color automatically?
AutoBackgroundColor.Hint: Uses the most frequent color of each picture as the Scene background color.

SceneTransition.Label: Scene Transition
SceneTransition.Hint: Transition animation used when switching to the created Scenes.
SceneTransition.WindMissing: The Wind transition was not found, so Foundry's default transition is selected.

Padding.Label: Padding (%)
Padding.Hint: Extra space around each picture, as a percentage of its size.

SceneFolder.Label: Scene folder
SceneFolder.Hint: Folder in the Scenes tab that receives the created Scenes.

ShowInNavigation.Label: Show in navigation bar?
ShowInNavigation.Hint: Whether the created Scenes appear in the top navigation bar.
